description: Print the contents of a file inside a running app container. Read-only; bound to safe roots (/app and /data only). Refuses files larger than 256KB; truncate by reading the first N bytes via path tricks if you need a tail. env="production" needs the app owner or a platform admin and a person's recent confirmation, like appcrane_reveal_secret: a call refused with STEP_UP_REQUIRED names a link for the user to open and confirm.

path.description: Absolute path inside the container, must start with /app or /data

name: appcrane_cat
